title: Banoffee Ice Cream Pops
description: Tiny cake-pop-style ice cream pops made from mashed banana, dulce de leche and Greek yoghurt. Like a frozen banoffee pie.

ingredients.text: 75g dulce de leche or thick toffee sauce

steps: Mash the banana to a pulp. Stir in the dulce de leche and yoghurt until well combined. Leave a few banana chunks for texture if desired.
Fill silicone cake-pop moulds with the mixture (top and bottom halves). Attach together and pipe in any remaining mixture through the hole. Freeze for at least 3 hours or overnight.
Remove from freezer for 10 minutes, push a stick through the hole in each mould, and return to freezer for 10 more minutes.
Release from moulds by running under a hot tap for 20 seconds.
notes: Makes 18 tiny cake pops. Delicious dipped in chocolate and sprinkles like a Fab lolly.
